# compress_folders

[← Command index](README.md)

Compress each folder in a directory into an archive of its own with 7-Zip.

## Synopsis

```
compress_folders [options]
```

## Description

Every folder directly inside the input directory is compressed into
`<folder>.<archive extension>` in the input directory. The archive holds the folder's
contents at its top level, not the folder itself. A folder whose archive already
exists is skipped.

Zip archives use Deflate at level 7 and 7z archives use 7-Zip's default method. Both
leave out NTFS timestamps and ask 7-Zip for a reproducible archive.

With `-s` the archive is split into volumes named `<archive>.001`, `.002` and so on;
if the folder fits in one volume, it is renamed back to the plain archive name.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-i, --input_path <input_path>` | Directory whose top-level folders are compressed; must exist. |
| `-a, --archive_type <archive_type>` | Archive format to create; only `ZIP` and `7Z` are supported. Default: `ZIP`. Allowed: `ZIP`, `INSTALL`, `7Z`, `RAR`, `TAR_BZ2`, `TB2`, `TBZ`, `TBZ2`, `TZ2`, `TAR_GZ`, `TAZ_GZ`, `TGZ`, `TAR_LZ`, `TAR_LZMA`, `TLZ`, `TAR_LZO`, `TAR_XZ`, `TXZ`, `TAR_Z`, `TZ`, `TAZ`, `TAR_ZST`, `TZST`, `ISO`, `EXE`, `APPIMAGE`. |
| `-w, --password <password>` | Password to encrypt the archives with; none when omitted. |
| `-s, --volume_size <volume_size>` | Split archives into volumes of this size, in 7-Zip's `-v` format such as `100m` or `4g`; not split when omitted. |
| `-d, --delete_originals` | Delete each folder after it is compressed. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Zip every folder in a directory

```bash
compress_folders -i /path/to/folders
```

### 7z every folder and delete the folders, previewing first

```bash
compress_folders -i /path/to/folders -a 7Z -d -p -v
```

### Make password-protected 7z archives split into 4092 MB volumes

```bash
compress_folders -i /path/to/folders -a 7Z -w secret -s 4092m
```

## Notes

- Use `ZIP` or `7Z`. Types that cannot be created, such as `RAR` or the tarball types, are refused for each folder with an error.
- 7-Zip must be installed as a JoyBox tool.
